usageNotes: Use this to modify an existing cluster-wide directory mapping — update its description, change node-to-path mappings via the `map` array, or remove individual settings using the `delete` field. Requires the `Mapping.Modify` privilege on `/mapping/dir/{id}`. Pass the `digest` field (retrieved from a prior GET) to guard against concurrent edits overwriting each other. Returns null on success; any error is signaled via HTTP status.

examples.summary: Update a shared-storage directory mapping to add a new node path and refresh its description

params.description: NFS share mounted on pve01 and pve02 under /mnt/nfs-share

tips: Use the `delete` field (comma-separated configid list) to unset optional fields like `description` without resending the full payload.
Fetch the current mapping with GET /cluster/mapping/dir/{id} first to obtain a valid `digest` value before modifying.
The `map` array format is node-keyed; each element typically follows `node=<nodename>,path=<absolute-path>` — verify the exact format against your PVE version's schema.
Directory mappings are cluster-wide; a change here affects how all nodes resolve the mapping ID to a local path.
